At Little Elly Heelalige, we believe every little moment is an opportunity to nurture kind, confident, and thoughtful children. 💛 Little ears are always listening, learning, and observing. The words we choose today can shape their tomorrow. Let’s fill their world with encouraging words, patience, kindness, and love—because every child deserves to grow up feeling heard and valued. 🌱✨

Our little shoppers at Little Elly Heelalige had so much fun with the Blue Basket Shopping Activity! 🛒💙 The children enjoyed picking and identifying blue-coloured objects while learning through a playful shopping experience. It was a simple yet exciting activity that encouraged colour recognition, observation, and confidence while making learning feel just like everyday life. Learning truly is more fun when children get to explore! ✨

When little ones have big emotions, they may struggle to control their reactions. Instead of seeing tantrums as misbehaviour, try to understand what your child is communicating. Stay calm, validate their feelings, and offer gentle guidance. Emotional regulation takes time and practice. Your patience, understanding, and consistent support help your child feel safe while learning to manage big feelings.

At Little Elly Heelalige, learning begins with little steps! ✏️✨ Our tracing activities help children strengthen fine-motor skills, hand-eye coordination, pencil control and early number recognition. From tracing lines in PlayGroup to following number tracks in Nursery, every activity makes learning playful, engaging and meaningful. 🌈🔢 Let little hands explore, practise and grow with confidence every day!

#LittleEllyHeelalige #PlayBasedLearning #PreschoolActivities #EarlyLearning #LearningThroughPlay

At Little Elly Heelalige, learning becomes an exciting hands-on experience! 🌈 Our little learners enjoyed the Infinity Walk activity to encourage coordination, focus, and movement, followed by pairing letters with pictures to strengthen early literacy and recognition skills. Through playful activities, children learn naturally, confidently, and joyfully—building strong foundations for their future learning journey. 💛

Our little learners discovered why the ozone layer is so important and how it protects our planet from harmful rays. Through fun, meaningful activities, children learned that caring for Earth starts with simple everyday choices. Let’s nurture environmentally responsible habits today and inspire our little ones to become tomorrow’s planet protectors. 🌱☀️ Together, every small step can make a big difference!

#WorldOzoneDay #OzoneDay #SaveOurPlanet #LittleElly #Heelalige

When big emotions take over, children may struggle to listen, reason, or respond calmly. A tantrum isn’t simply bad behaviour—it can be a sign that their emotional system needs support. Stay calm, reduce the pressure, and connect before correcting. When your child feels safe and regulated, communication becomes easier. Let’s help little minds grow through understanding, patience, and connection. 🌿

#LittleEllyHeelalige #PositiveParenting #TantrumTips #EmotionalRegulation #GentleParenting

Little hands, big discoveries! 🌿🔷 Our Montessori learners explored Shape Construction and the Sensorial Natural Table, turning hands-on experiences into meaningful learning. From building with geometric forms to touching, observing, sorting and exploring natural materials, children developed concentration, creativity, coordination and sensory awareness. Because when children learn through their hands, they don’t just remember—they understand, experiment and discover with confidence. 💛
